title: IG-12
subtitle: Independent
description: IG-11 was a standard issue Assassin Droid sent in pursuit of Grogu. After being reprogrammed by Kuiil, IG-11 became an ally and was charged with protecting Grogu. Following the Droid's destruction, a group of Anzellan Droidsmiths, in an attempt to reconstruct him, refurbished his salvaged parts and created a pilotable frame for Grogu. Now IG-12, this new body offered him some added protection as well as a way to be more mobile and enter the fight.
